create_anyvectmse_metric: create an AnyVectMSE metric instance to track mean squared error with configurable scale and reduction mode
compute_codebook_entropy: compute codebook entropy using CodebookEntropy to measure codeword usage distribution across quantization steps
manage_metrics_with_manager: manage a set of metrics using MetricsManager to update, compute, and track best values across splits
use_timer_context: use the Timer class as a context manager to measure elapsed time for code blocks with millisecond precision
aggregate_timers_with_manager: aggregate multiple named timers using TimersManager to track and sum elapsed time across operations
